practicals.title: Prepare a ORIENT workbook using following function:
content: Prepare a ORIENT workbook using following function:
 Add heading as a Orient Industries Ltd. in range B2:D2
 Format the label in the range A4:F4, Create border lines above and below
this range. Also create a border line below range A10:F10
 Add label Item in cell A4, Quantity in cell B4, Unit price in cell C4 and
gross values in D4.
 Enter sales Tax Rate in cell A6 and 8% in cell B6 with two decimal places.
 Use the TODAY() function in cell E10 and NOW() in cell F10.Format cell
in the mmm dd,yyyy(e.g. Jan 21,2021) format.
 Change the date format to dd-mmm-yy(e.g.14-Jan-21) format.
